tools.name: search_items
tools.description: Read-only and free. Search the Klarhimmel UI catalogue (blocks, components, app screens, templates) by words in name, title or description. Returns up to 20 matches with name, kind, title and description; pass a name to get_item for the install command.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Read-only and free. One item by its exact name (from search_items): title, description, the install command, its page URL and Markdown twin URL, and its dependencies.

tools.name: setup
tools.description: Read-only and free. Returns the setup steps (the text of /setup.md) for adding Klarhimmel UI to a React project: Tailwind, alias, components.json, first block, tokens, design skill. Follow them once per project.
